meta.title: MafiaGameUA: Mafia online with cameras
meta.description: Play Mafia with cameras and microphones: 11 players and a host at one table.

hero.title: The city falls asleep.
hero.lede: Mafia with cameras and microphones. Eleven players, one host, and a table where you can see every face.
hero.tableLabel: A table for 11 players and a host
hero.lineup: The Don, 2 mafia, the Sheriff, the Doctor and 6 civilians. Roles are dealt automatically when the host starts the table.
hero.codeError: Type the room code (letters and digits) or paste the link.
howToSteps: Create a room and pick a host password.
Send your friends the link. Each takes a free seat.
Press Start. Roles are dealt for you, and the panel guides you from there.
hero.tablesNone: No open tables right now. Create your own!
hero.drawHint: The real deck: Don, 2 Mafia, Sheriff, Doctor and 6 civilians. The card is truly random.

game.title: How a game goes
game.lede: The game runs in rounds: day, night, day again. It ends when the mafia are found out, or when there are as many mafia as civilians.

steps.name: Introduction
steps.text: The first night. Everyone sees their role card, and the mafia open their eyes to recognise each other. All cameras and mics are off.

steps.name: Speeches
steps.text: Day breaks. The host gives the floor in seat order, and everyone has one minute to convince the table.

steps.name: Nominations
steps.text: During their minute, a player can put someone up for the vote by naming a seat number.

steps.name: Vote
steps.text: The table votes on the nominees. The player voted out says a last word, then the host turns off their camera and mic.

steps.name: Night
steps.text: The mafia shoot, the Don hunts for the Sheriff, the Sheriff checks a player. In the morning the host says who was killed.

host.title: The host runs the table
host.lede: The host sees every role and controls each player's camera and mic. A player can't turn back on what the host turned off.

items.name: Camera and mic
items.text: Turns them on or off for any of the eleven players.

items.name: Quiet table
items.text: One click leaves only the speaker's mic on.

items.name: Kill
items.text: Marks a player as killed, and their camera and mic stay off for the rest of the game.

items.name: Timer and fouls
items.text: Gives the floor, pauses the minute, records warnings.

footer.note: The first version runs on the host's own computer.

room.title: Rooms are being built
room.text: The next update adds a room with cameras for 11 players and a host.

role.title: Your role
role.civilianText: Find the mafia and vote them out.
role.sheriffText: Each night, check one player. The host tells you if they are mafia.
role.mafiaText: Each night, choose with your team who to kill. Don't give yourself away by day.
role.donText: You lead the mafia. Each night, hunt for the Sheriff.
role.doctorText: Each night, choose someone to save. If the mafia shoot them, they survive.

create.title: New room
create.lede: You'll be the host. Send the link to the players and they'll take their seats.
create.name: Room name
create.passwordHint: You need it to get back into the host seat.
create.share: Send this link to the players

join.title: Take a seat
join.nicknameHint: The other players will see it.
join.seatTip: You get a seat automatically. Type “4. Olia” to sit in seat 4 straight away, or change your seat later in Settings.

lobby.title: Camera and mic check
lobby.lede: This is how the others will see and hear you. Check it before the game starts.
lobby.levelHint: Say something: the bar should move.
lobby.denied: The browser blocked the camera or mic. Click the lock icon next to the site address, allow them, then reload the page.

preview.title: What the room will look like
preview.lede: A sample with made-up players. The real room arrives with the camera connection.

settings.title: Settings
settings.seatHint: Pick your number. Taken numbers are greyed out.

ui.dragHint: Drag your tile onto another seat to change your number. Seats lock when the game starts.

prefs.effectsHint: Everyone sees the blur or background. Works in Chrome and Edge.
prefs.effectsNo: This browser can't change the camera background.
prefs.sfxHint: The night shot and other table sounds.
prefs.calmHint: Less motion: no lamp flicker or hopping.
prefs.mirrorHint: Like a mirror. Others don't see you mirrored.
prefs.voiceHint: Briefly announces who wakes up, in different words each time.

roles.name: Don
roles.text: Head of the mafia. Hunts for the Sheriff at night.

roles.name: Mafia
roles.text: Two of them. Each night they choose, with the Don, who to kill.

roles.name: Sheriff
roles.text: At night, checks a player: mafia or not.

roles.name: Doctor
roles.text: At night, saves one player from the shot.

roles.name: Civilians
roles.text: Six of them. They have only their vote and their wits.

roomUi.createLede: You will be the host. Players join with the link you share.
roomUi.passwordHint: At least 4 characters. You need it to come back as the host from another device.
roomUi.notFound: This room doesn't exist or has closed.
roomUi.offline: Can't reach the game server. Is it running?
roomUi.kicked: The host removed you from this room.

errors.seat_taken: Someone just took that seat. Pick another.
errors.game_in_progress: The game has started. You can watch as a spectator.
errors.invalid_role_mix: That role mix doesn't fit the number of players.
errors.game_ended: The game is over. Start a new game first.
errors.offline: No connection to the game server.
errors.video_failed: Couldn't connect to the video server.
errors.media_denied: The browser blocked the camera or mic. Allow them in the address bar.
errors.media_failed: The camera or mic couldn't start.
errors.not_enough_players: At least 3 players are needed to start.
errors.seats_locked: Seats are locked once the game starts.
errors.not_speeches: You can put players up only during speeches.
errors.not_voting: There is no vote right now.
errors.heal_blocked: The Doctor can't heal this player tonight.
errors.too_many_tries: Too many wrong tries. Wait 10 minutes.
errors.too_many_spectators: Too many spectators, no room left.

roomUi.watchHint: Spectators see and hear the table by day, but take no seat and never see roles or the night.
roomUi.youWatch: You are watching as a spectator
roomUi.publicTable: Show the table on the home page
roomUi.publicTableHint: Others will see it in the list of tables and can watch. The code and host password stay secret.

hostPanel.title: Host controls
hostPanel.lobbyHint: Players can drag their tile to change their seat number. Seats lock when the game starts.
hostPanel.startHint: Deals the roles (Don, 2 Mafia, Sheriff, Doctor, the rest civilians) and starts the introduction round. Needs at least 3 players.
hostPanel.nominateHint: Tap the seat the speaker names. Tap again to take it back.
hostPanel.firstMustNominate: The first speaker hasn't put anyone up yet.
hostPanel.noNominees: Nobody is up for the vote yet.
hostPanel.votedHint: Tap the seats that raise a hand. Each player votes once.
hostPanel.lastCandidate: Everyone who hasn't voted ({n}) votes against seat {seat}.

pickHint.mafia: Tap the seat the mafia shoots.
pickHint.don: Tap the seat the Don checks.
pickHint.sheriff: Tap the seat the Sheriff checks.
pickHint.doctor: Tap the seat the Doctor heals.

hostPanel.suggestTown: No mafia left: the town has won.
hostPanel.suggestMafia: The mafia equals the town: the mafia has won.
hostPanel.newGameHint: Keeps the players in their seats, clears roles, kills and fouls.
hostPanel.pickPlayer: Click a player's tile for their camera, mic, fouls and more.
hostPanel.fourFouls: 4 fouls: the player leaves the game.
hostPanel.botsHint: Test mode: bots have no camera, but you can run a whole game with them.
hostPanel.asleepHint: Players' mics are off. Cameras keep running, but at night players and spectators see nobody. When everyone's eyes are closed, wake the mafia.

awakeHint.mafia: The mafia and Don cameras, no sound: they agree in silence. Only you and the mafia see them.
awakeHint.don: You see only the Don's camera. Nobody else does.
awakeHint.sheriff: You see only the Sheriff's camera. Nobody else does.
awakeHint.doctor: You see only the Doctor's camera. Nobody else does.

hostPanel.roleOut: {role}: this role is already out. Call it out loud anyway so the table can't tell, then press "Nobody".
hostPanel.locationHint: Pick a place, and everyone introduces themselves as if they were there.
hostPanel.publicTable: Show the table on the home page
hostPanel.publicTableHint: So others can watch the game.
hostPanel.recordHint: A text file with the roles and everything that happened. The night is in it too, so don't show it before the game ends.
hostPanel.recordOngoing: Result: the game is still on

locations.name: Night train Kyiv to Odesa
locations.text: A four-berth compartment, tea in metal holders, dark steppe outside.

locations.name: Casino in Monte Carlo
locations.text: Roulette, cigar smoke and a croupier who sees everything.

locations.name: Chicago jazz club, 1930s
locations.text: Prohibition, a saxophone and whiskey from under the counter.

locations.name: A Sicilian wedding
locations.text: The Don is receiving guests, and nobody refuses an invitation.

locations.name: Ocean liner
locations.text: A ball in the first-class saloon, three days from shore.

locations.name: Mountain chalet
locations.text: Snowstorm, the pass is closed, a fireplace and mulled wine.

locations.name: The office before the party
locations.text: Someone stole the bonuses and the lift is stuck between floors.

locations.name: A village in Poltava region
locations.text: Dumplings, neighbours' gossip and a cow that has seen too much.

locations.name: A coffee house in Lviv
locations.text: Rain, cobblestones and coffee brewed here for a hundred years.

locations.name: Film set
locations.text: We're shooting a gangster film, but someone rewrote the script.

locations.name: Museum at night
locations.text: The alarm is off and the painting is still there. But is it real?

locations.name: Space station
locations.text: Half a year from Earth, enough air for all, not enough trust.

locations.name: Desert island
locations.text: The plane went down, the radio is silent, not enough coconuts for all.

locations.name: Old mountain hotel
locations.text: The porter has vanished, and the light is on in room 13.

locations.name: Birthday at the dacha
locations.text: Barbecue, a guitar, and a cake with one slice missing.

locations.name: Wedding in Vegas
locations.text: Someone got married, someone lost everything, nobody remembers a thing.

locations.name: School reunion
locations.text: Twenty years on. Everyone has changed except the old grudges.

locations.name: Submarine
locations.text: Two hundred metres down, periscope up, the captain says nothing.

locations.name: Travelling circus
locations.text: The clowns aren't laughing and the tiger tamer is in a hurry.

locations.name: Odesa market
locations.text: They'll sell you anything here, even your alibi.

locations.name: Castle in the Carpathians
locations.text: A thunderstorm, candles and ancestors' portraits whose eyes follow you.

locations.name: Diamond auction
locations.text: A rare stone is up for sale, and someone has already forged the certificate.

locations.name: Music festival
locations.text: Tents, mud, and the headliner is two hours late.

locations.name: Last metro train
locations.text: The station is closed, the lights flicker, no phone signal.

locations.name: Bakery at 4 a.m.
locations.text: The dough is rising, and there are footprints in the flour.

locations.name: Embassy reception
locations.text: Champagne, diplomats and a coded message on a napkin.

locations.name: Island prison
locations.text: The escape is set for tonight, but there's an informer among the inmates.
